Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In the “Analyze Optimal Strategy” step, the Orchestrator proposed code that sets each guess to the minimum of the actual (unknown) box counts for each distribution (i.e., guesses depend on the realized distribution). Bob must choose guesses before seeing the distribution and under adversarial permutation, so this is an invalid strategy model. This faulty modeling led to computing an incorrect guaranteed minimum (the $3,000 claim), making the final answer wrong.
